summary_en: Nippon Life announced on 11 December 2024 that it agreed to buy the roughly 77% of Resolution Life Group Holdings it doesn't already own, for about US$8.2 billion (about ¥1.2 trillion), making it a wholly owned subsidiary. It also agreed to buy NAB's 20% stake in MLC for about A$500 million. The next business day after completion, it will combine MLC and Resolution Life Australasia under an Australian holding company in which it holds 51% directly and 49% indirectly. Completion is expected in the second half of 2025, subject to regulatory approvals.
